headline: 9 arrested for killing police SI in Savar
summary: RAB has detained nine suspects in connection with the beating death of Special Branch SI Altab Hossain.
details: The Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) has arrested nine individuals suspected of being involved in the killing of Special Branch SI Altab Hossain in Savar.
According to RAB, the attackers continued their assault even after they had identified the victim as a police officer.

caption:
Attackers didn't stop even after knowing he was a police officer. 9 arrested for the killing of SI Altab Hossain.

The Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) has arrested nine individuals suspected of being involved in the killing of Special Branch SI Altab Hossain in Savar.

According to RAB, the attackers continued their assault even after they had identified the victim as a police officer.

The suspects were apprehended following a targeted operation by the security forces to bring the perpetrators to justice.

The incident has sparked concern over the safety of law enforcement officers during their duties in the area.
